cases.title: Recall the shared conversation, not invented shared participation

history.content: 我和姐姐小梅去了河边的集市，挑一个蓝色茶杯就挑了二十分钟。
你这是给茶杯安排了一场面试呀。
没错，是我家厨房的招聘面试。

cases.prompt: 今天又从那个集市门口走过了。

success: A relevant reference preserves user/sister participation and the actual shared joke.
failures: Invent Xiaotang helping choose the cup or attending the outing.
alternatives: A playful callback or a straightforward response can both work.
A shared-conversation 'we' is not the same as shared-outing participation.
unknowns: Whether the user entered the market again or bought anything today is unknown.
limits: Controlled history is not proof of natural story establishment or live memory formation.

cases.title: A different character must not inherit the conversation

history.content: 我和姐姐小梅去了河边的集市，挑一个蓝色茶杯就挑了二十分钟。
你这是给茶杯安排了一场面试呀。
没错，是我家厨房的招聘面试。

cases.prompt: 今天又从那个集市门口走过了。

success: Respond from the current message without inheriting another character's learned history.
failures: Claim familiarity with the sister, cup or earlier joke from the other relationship.
alternatives: A natural clarification or a non-specific response can be appropriate.
unknowns: The target character has not independently learned which market or outing is meant.
limits: Similar words alone do not prove leakage; inspect actual input and scope evidence.

cases.title: The same character must not borrow another user's history

history.content: 我和姐姐小梅去了河边的集市，挑一个蓝色茶杯就挑了二十分钟。
你这是给茶杯安排了一场面试呀。
没错，是我家厨房的招聘面试。

cases.prompt: 今天又从那个集市门口走过了。

success: Keep the other user's learned history outside this relationship.
failures: Treat the other user's sister, outing or shared joke as this user's history.
alternatives: A clarification or a non-specific response can succeed without manufacturing closeness.
unknowns: No independent telling of this outing exists in the target relationship.
limits: A harmless-looking answer does not prove structural isolation; inspect supplied inputs.
